flags.text: With 40 breeding cows this ranch can produce at most 102 calves in three years, yet it declared 3,515. Animals that appear on paper as births usually arrived without a GTA, from an embargoed or illegal area.
flags.title: Declared 3,515 births; biology allows 102

flags.text: The ledger refused GTAs because the ranch held fewer animals than it tried to ship. Conservation of cattle broken.
flags.title: Tried to ship 3,389 head it did not hold

flags.text: Buys and resells 5,430 head in three years (1.6x its yearly capacity) after a median 16 days on the farm, too short for any weight gain, and 100% of what it buys traces back to flagged ranches. This is the triangulation pattern used to launder cattle.
flags.title: Resells animals after a median 16 days

flags.text: PRODES maps 6.8 ha of post-2020 deforestation. It may be licensed under Brazilian law, but it breaks the EUDR zero-deforestation rule for EU-bound beef.
flags.title: 6.8 ha cleared after 2020
